title: 871. Profitable Schemes

examples.explanation: Running only the second scheme earns 3, and running both earns 5; both plans fit in 5 members.
Every non-empty collection earns at least 5 and uses at most 10 members, giving 2^3 - 1 = 7 plans.
The single scheme fits and earns exactly 1.
